Merge grid-subset VCMoE fits

Source: R/fit.R
vcmoe_merge_grid_fits.Rd

Combines vcmoe_grid_part objects returned by vcmoe_fit() with control$grid_subset (for example one per cluster job) into an ordinary vcmoe fit. Every grid point must be covered. When several parts cover the same grid point (for example a cold-start pass and a neighbour warm-start pass), a converged local fit is preferred, then the one with the higher penalized local objective. Label alignment is then run over the whole grid as in a serial fit.

Usage

vcmoe_merge_grid_fits(parts, label = NULL)

Arguments

parts

A list of vcmoe_grid_part objects from the same data and settings.

label

Optional label-alignment override: "align", "global" or "greedy". The default keeps the alignment of the original call.

Value

A vcmoe object; diagnostics$grid_source records which part supplied each grid point.
